The new-conversation column should be a transcript and one composer. Chrome that only says “nothing to configure” comes off this screen; the image control becomes a “+” that also accepts a drop; typing shows the caret and no ring. The icon rail (`.view-rail`) and the Chats sidebar (`.application-controls`) stay as they are. This pass only changes `ConversationView`, the composer and the pieces it renders, the empty-workspace composer that reuses those pieces, and the shell footer only by leaving it alone. ## Central idea On an empty conversation the main column centres one raised composer: placeholder, a “+”, harness and model chips, and Send. After the first message, the transcript scrolls and the composer sits on the bottom edge. The OpenPane composer (raised surface, 22px radius, accent Send pill, existing tokens) stays. A control remains on this screen only when it can do something for this conversation. A provider that does not report permissions does not get a Permissions card. A namespace whose `modules` array is empty does not get a Custom tools fieldset. Non-empty conversation modules move to the Extensions screen, which already lists those namespaces. A claimed content layout still receives the modules slot and may place it. ## Where each current element goes | Element | Placement | |---|---| | Header (“Your conversation”, agent label, border) | Removed. The section keeps `aria-label="Conversation"`. The model chip already shows the agent label (the screenshot repeats “GPT-6.2 Sol” in the header and the chip). Eyebrow and scope label are already `display: none`. | | Permissions card | Unmounted when `PermissionState` has no listing. Codex “does not report permissions” matches that (the empty-listing sentence in `ConversationPermissions` is different: “No active work-item permissions were found.”). When a listing is present, the same `region` named Permissions, including “Refresh permissions”, stays between the transcript and the composer. | | “Send a message to begin.” | Removed, including the recorded-demonstration variant. The textarea placeholder remains the prompt (`Write to Codex…`, and the existing recorded placeholder). | | Custom tools fieldsets | Ready and `modules.length === 0`: render nothing (this is the crew and coworkers case: both return `modules: []`). Loading and failed: stay in the conversation column as the current status line and the alert “Custom tools could not load.” Ready and non-empty: Extensions panel, not this column. A claimed `contentLayout` still receives the modules slot. | | Add image | A “+” at the start of the composer footer. Accessible name stays “Add image”, or “Replace image” when `view.image` is set. The hidden file input keeps `aria-label="Image file"`. The composer is also the drop target. | | Effort chip (“Default”, disabled) | Removed. No replacement. The host still has no effort setting. | | Composer disclosure (“Local Codex · Approvals required for changes”) | Removed from view. The same `presentation.footer` string stays in a `visually-hidden` paragraph in the composer so the policy sentence remains in the accessibility tree. The host name stays visible as the shell footer build label. | | Shell footer (“● Conversation connected”, “Local Codex host”) | Unchanged, in `DesktopShell`. `Shell.tsx` is not edited. | | Composer focus ring (`.composer:focus-within`) | Removed. Button `:focus-visible` outlines stay. | | Textarea resize grip | Removed (`resize: none`). `rows={3}`, `min-height: 54px`, and `max-height: 160px` stay; extra text scrolls inside the field. | ## Wireframes Rail and Chats sidebar are unchanged and omitted. Width stays `min(100%, 820px)`. Empty new conversation (no messages, Codex, no listing, no modules): ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ │ │ ╭────────────────────────────╮ │ │ │ Write to Codex… │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ + Codex ▾ GPT-6.2 ▾ │ │ │ │ Send │ │ │ ╰────────────────────────────╯ │ │ │ │ ● Conversation connected Local Codex host │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` The caret is the only focus indicator inside the field. There is no header, permissions card, empty-state line, Custom tools box, effort chip, disclosure line, or resize grip. Active conversation, one pending image (composer pinned; image not sent yet): ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ You │ │ ╭────────────────────────╮ │ │ │ Look at this diagram. │ │ │ ╰────────────────────────╯ │ │ │ │ Codex │ │ I see a box and an arrow. │ │ │ │ ╭──────────────────────────────────────────╮ │ │ │ Write to Codex… │ │ │ │ ┌ chart.png · 70 B Ready ┐ │ │ │ │ │ Remove │ │ │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ + Codex ▾ GPT-6.2 ▾ Send │ │ │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────╯ │ │ ● Conversation connected Local Codex host │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` “+” is named “Replace image” while a pending image exists. Send stays on the existing `canSend` rule (image `ready`, or non-empty draft). After send, the chip leaves the composer and the message uses the current `ImageAttachmentCard`. When Crew has a listing, the empty centred layout is not used. The Permissions region sits under the transcript and above the composer, with the same headings and buttons as today, including “Refresh permissions”. ## Drag-and-drop states Drop chrome is local UI state on the composer form. The pending image remains `view.image` from `useConversation(active.store)`. Invalid drops never call the store. | State | What the user sees | Data | |---|---|---| | Idle | No drop outline. “+” enabled when `acceptsImages`, `enabled`, no `storageFailure`, and status is not `uploading`. | Store unchanged. | | Drag-over | `data-drop="over"`: dashed accent outline only while a file is over the composer, plus “Drop PNG or JPEG” (or “Drop to replace” if a chip is already there). This outline is not the typing ring. | Store unchanged. `dropEffect = "copy"`. | | Invalid type or size | Outline clears. Alert: “Choose a PNG or JPEG image.” or the existing “Choose an image of at most 4 MB.” Draft and current image stay. | No `selectImage`. | | Uploading | Existing chip status “Uploading…”. “+” and further drops disabled. | `selectImage({ name, bytes })` in flight, via the current `imageAction` error path. | | Ready | Chip status “Ready”, Remove available. Send follows `canSend`. | `view.image.status === 'ready'`. | | Failed | Status is `image.reason` or “Upload interrupted”, with Retry and Remove. | Existing `retryImage` / `removeImage`. `imageError` still uses `role="alert"`. | Pointer flow on the composer `
